newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Premiere to set up gaming unit.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Premiere to set up gaming unit.

text.p: The Philippines' Premiere Entertainment Productions Inc said on Wednesday it will set up a new company to manage and operate bingo parlors.
Premiere president Cirio Santiago said that Premiere will subscribe to 51 percent of the company's authorised capital stock. Santiago and other investors will subscribe to the remaining amount.
The company will be named Premium Events Palace Inc. Premiere is the Philippines only listed movie production company.
Premiere on Wednesday closed unchanged at 3.60 pesos.
